parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/order/order.service.ts is in the application layer. The rubric says an application file must not throw HTTP errors from a web or transport package. OrderService.create throws BadRequestException and OrderService.findOne throws NotFoundException. Both come from @nestjs/common and stand for HTTP 400 and 404 responses, which belong to the presentation layer. The service should throw its own application or domain errors and let the controller or an exception filter turn them into HTTP responses. Three things here are not violations. The @Injectable decorator and the injected TypeORM Repository in the constructor are allowed in an application file: the framework-decorator ban covers domain files only, and constructor parameters count as dependency wiring. The optional context parameter is typed CreateContextDto, an interface the project declares itself, so it is not a framework request type.
